newsitem.title: GERMANY: German chemical sector 96 sales fell 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: German chemical sector 96 sales fell 2 pct.

text.p: Turnover in the German chemical industry fell two percent in 1996 to just under 177 billion marks, Juergen Strube, president of the German chemical industry association VCI said on Thursday.
"The reasons for this were on one hand the unsatisfactory price situation and on the other hand weak demand, especially in Germany," Strube said.
The VCI said that production grew 0.5 percent while producer prices fell 3.5 percent in 1996.
The VCI predicted a slightly more favourable economic environment in 1997.
"Most of our members expect a somewhat more favourable development of the economy for 1997 than in the previous year and corresponding growth," Strube said.
